title: A large pothole near the bus stand is causing two-wheelers to swerve into oncoming traffic.
description: Large pothole near the bus stand. Two-wheelers are swerving into oncoming traffic to avoid it.
resolutionNotes: Remediation verified on site: pothole filled with dense bitumen and surface rolled flat.

title: Significant road damage and hazard near Racecourse Road
description: Road damage and deep pothole causing traffic obstruction and vehicle hazard near Racecourse Road, Rangoli Halla.
resolutionNotes: Remediation verified on site: pothole filled with dense bitumen and surface rolled flat.

title: Large pothole near the main bus stop
description: A deep pothole has formed on the left lane right before the bus stop. Two-wheelers are swerving into traffic to avoid it.

title: Streetlights out on the entire lane
description: Six streetlights between the school gate and the water tank have been off for four nights. The stretch is completely dark.

title: Garbage piling up beside the market gate
description: Waste has not been collected for three days. It is spreading onto the footpath and smells strongly in the afternoon.

title: Drain overflowing after the night rain
description: The roadside drain is blocked and water is standing across the junction. Shops on the corner are affected.

title: Repaired footpath near the government school
description: Cracked slabs outside the school entrance were replaced and the surface has been levelled.

title: Traffic signal stuck on amber
description: The signal at the circle keeps blinking amber during peak hours and vehicles are crossing unpredictably.

title: Park lights and broken benches
description: Two benches near the walking track are broken and the garden lights stay off in the evening.

title: Water leaking from the main pipeline
description: Continuous leakage at the pipeline joint is wasting water and softening the road shoulder.
